releaseNotes:
Nokiatis MUC 1.19.0 — the big honest update.

CLOSING THE APP NOW REMEMBERS EVERYTHING
- Kill or close the app while music plays: playback stops automatically, and the exact second you were on is saved — the next launch resumes precisely there.
- The saved position now reaches storage DURING playback (a guaranteed ~5-second anchor) instead of a debounce that never fired while music kept playing — so background listening can no longer lose minutes.
- The resume point is visible on the bar before you even press play; relaunch can no longer accidentally zero it; a finished track restarts cleanly instead of resuming at its end; widget resume honors the saved second too.

HOME — THE PODCASTS AND EVERYTHING ACTUALLY WORK
- A real Podcasts shelf on the Home page: real, playable 30-90 minute episodes from the catalogue, with a Browse-all hand-off into Search — not just a look anymore.
- The Podcasts chip fills with real episodes (the old songs-only filter used to eat them) and shows an honest empty state when the network has nothing.
- "Charts" is now honestly "Trending now" with a tap-to-retry row instead of silently vanishing; the MIXES cards and the featured hero say what they really are; album cards open the full Album screen with an instant-play badge.

THE SEEK BAR — FINAL WORD
- A confirmed scrub releases the bar instantly (the wait was a fallback, not the rule); while buffering the hold extends instead of ever snapping back; a track change mid-scrub cancels cleanly; pause no longer ticks the label backwards; livestreams get a LIVE mode; double-tap the bar for ±10s; VoiceOver users can finally seek with increment/decrement actions; hour-long tracks format as h:mm:ss.

LIQUID GLASS — FASTER AND PRETTIER
- The player screen now updates once a second instead of 50 times per second — massively smoother and lighter on battery — while the bar itself stays silky.
- MiniPlayer: gradient progress, a light sweep on track change, top-lit glass edge. The tab dock glows and reacts to touch. Sheets got true glass sheen. The equalizer animates on the native thread. The blue "Ocean" theme became jade — the palette stays in-family.

REAL STATISTICS, RICHER — STILL 100% REAL
- The website's owner statistics now show New today, Sessions today, latest-version adoption and a 24-hour UTC heartbeat chart — every number still comes only from the app's anonymous heartbeat (random id, version, timestamps — never your library or personal data), with the off-switch in Settings.
- The counters self-heal (a lost start-beat is repaid on the next beat), and one broken phone clock can never wipe the data anymore.

MANDATORY
- This release is mandatory: installs below 32 lock with the full-screen update screen until 1.19.0 is installed. It installs over your current version with the same Team Nokiatis signature — your library, playlists and downloads stay exactly where they are.

— بالعربية: هذا أكبر تحديث حتى الآن. عند إغلاق التطبيق أو حذفه من المشغّلات أثناء تشغيل الموسيقى: يتوقف الصوت تلقائيًا ويُحفظ الثانية نفسها التي كنت عليها — والتطبيق يستأنف من نفسها عند فتحه من جديد. صفحة البداية أصبحت حقيقية بالكامل: قسم بودكاست حقيقي بحلقات قابلة للتشغيل، و"الأكثر رواجًا الآن" بصدق مع زر إعادة، وبطاقات الألبوم تفتح صفحة الألبوم. شريط التقدّم وصل لكماله النهائي: لا قفزة خلفية أبدًا، لا انتكاس عند التخزين المؤقت، نقرة مزدوجة ±10 ثوانٍ، ودعم قارئ الشاشة. التطبيق أخف وأسرع بكثير (شاشة المشغّل تتحدّث مرة كل ثانية بدل 50)، والزجاج السائل أجمل: توهّج الشريط السفلي، لمعان عند تغيّر الأغنية، ومظهر "Ocean" الأزرق أصبح يشابة خضراء. وإحصائياتك الحية على الموقع ازدادت ثراءً: جديدة اليوم، جلسات اليوم، نسبة أحدث إصدار، ومخطط نبضات آخر 24 ساعة — وكلها 100% حقيقية من نبضة مجهولة تمامًا يمكن إيقافها من الإعدادات. التحديث إجباري ويُثبَّت فوق نسختك بتوقيع فريق نوكياتيس نفسه — كل شيء يبقى مكانه.
